faqs.q: How long does a custom practice website take?
faqs.a: Typical timeline is 4 to 6 weeks from kickoff to launch, depending on page count and content readiness. We move faster with structured milestones and weekly reviews.
We build with HIPAA-aware architecture — encrypted forms, secure hosting with BAA-ready partners, no PHI in analytics, and audit trails on submissions.

faqs.q: Do I own the design and code?
faqs.a: Yes. On launch, full ownership of design files, code, and content transfers to you. No lock-in, no proprietary CMS.
Keyword-mapped H1/H2 structure, schema markup (LocalBusiness, MedicalClinic, FAQ), optimized meta, internal linking, and image alt/optimization across every page.

faqs.q: Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Website Care plans cover updates, security, backups, uptime monitoring, performance tuning, and monthly content edits.

faqs.q: How long does it take to launch a new practice site?
faqs.a: Most projects go live in 4–6 weeks — from discovery to launch. Timelines depend on content readiness and scope, and we share a clear week-by-week roadmap during onboarding.

faqs.q: Do you handle HIPAA compliance and patient privacy?
faqs.a: Yes. Every build is HIPAA-aware: secure hosting, encrypted forms, BAA-ready integrations for contact and intake, and a compliance review before launch.

faqs.q: Will my new website actually help me rank on Google?
faqs.a: SEO is engineered in from day one — dermatology-specific schema, service and location pages, Core Web Vitals of 95+, and an on-page structure built to earn rankings for the searches that drive bookings.
